name: UGC 8331 (Hubble)
blurb: UGC 8331, a dwarf galaxy in the Canes Venatici I Cloud, seen by Hubble.
label: ugc08331-hubble
story: This galaxy is one of the many dwarfs that crowd the Canes Venatici I Cloud. Hubble picked out its individual stars so astronomers could measure its distance from the brightest of its red giants and map the cloud in three dimensions.

claims.text: UGC 8331 is one of the dwarf galaxies of the Canes Venatici I Cloud studied with Hubble program 10905
Its distance was measured from the tip of the red giant branch
The Canes Venatici I region is rich in dwarf galaxies, and accurate distances let nearby groups be resolved in three dimensions
UGC 8331 is a member of the Canes Venatici I Cloud
